And at the same time, the Brutusaur mount has returned to the in-game shop for a limited time. And we only have until January 7th to buy it, which means we need one more WoW token, our sixth, to convert into battleet balance and secure the Brutusaur and soon. So roughly 150,000 gold still stands between us and that goal. So today's mission is simple. We leverage everything we have available. housing driven market shifts, Westfell farms, trade goods, and smart selling to close that gap and make a serious push towards the brut. But dense stone would be a bottleneck because if we level enchanted 240 to craft the decor before we stockpile enough stone, we would be completely stuck because we can't get dense stone without highle mining. So we need to push mining up to roughly 230 just so we can farm thorium reliably to build a dense stone back reserve. For now, I'm planning to stockpile enough of these materials for about 10 campfires. This should be enough to test the market. And if they sell fast, great. We can always resupply later. If not, we don't waste too much time gathering materials that don't sell. And remember, as far as the next zone goes, Dunaro is a dwarf and gnome starting zone. And honestly, I think it's brilliant because it's essentially a new gathering skill, but with zero barriers. It doesn't take up a profession slot, which is really good for Goldie. There's no level requirements, and all you need is a wood cutting axe, which you can pick up from your housing neighborhood. Once you have that, trees across the world start spawning wood cutting nodes. And each expansion has its own type of lumber for its own decor crafts. Lumber is warb band accountbound, which basically means you can't sell it on the auction house.
